_comment: Persona: a third-party MCP client (for example ChatGPT) that must reach a deliberate read-only subset and nothing else. See G3-12. Authenticating a client establishes who is calling and says nothing about what it may do; without the abac_rules block below, any authenticated client inherits the entire tool surface, including execute as the service account and the Microsoft 365 send surface. The mcp_clients digest here is all zeros so this template is fail-closed as shipped: replace it with a real SHA-256 before use.
